title: Hollow and Spire
premise: When the border wards of Thornfell collapse and the stars vanish in the same terrible night, cartographer Rafael Okafor discovers her maps were never of smuggler roads at all — they were fragments of a dying country's memory, drawn by an ancestor who bound Thornfell to dragon-fire. Trapped inside borders that no longer officially exist, Rafael joins a ragged found family: a disgraced ward-keeper, a starless astronomer, and a half-dragon child who remembers the fire. As the last flame gutters, she must find the Hollow Door — the way out of a country erased from every map but hers — and choose whether to escape alone or spend her inheritance relighting the fire that will make Thornfell real again. She chooses to stay, becoming the new keeper of the spire, and the stars return one by one over a country reborn.
about_author: Odile Eriksen is the pen name of a former surveyor who spent six years mapping remote mountain passes before turning to fiction. She writes fantasy about people who make their living from edges — borders, coastlines, and the spaces between names.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Rafael Okafor, guiding a smuggling run through the Thornfell passes, watches the stars extinguish overhead and feels the border wards snap like cut harp strings. Her maps begin rewriting themselves in her satchel. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: dread and disorientation as the familiar world becomes unmappable.

chapters.title: A Country That Isn't There
chapters.summary: Rafael reaches the lowland town of Vess to discover official records of Thornfell have vanished; traders deny the mountains exist. A customs officer confiscates her satchel, calling the maps forgeries. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: gaslighting isolation — she alone remembers a whole country.

chapters.title: The Ward-Keeper's Daughter
chapters.summary: Imre Vashti, a disgraced ward-keeper, recognizes Rafael's surname on the confiscated maps and breaks her out of custody, claiming the Okafors helped build the wards generations ago. POV: Imre. Emotional beat: reluctant alliance born of guilt and desperation.

chapters.title: What the Maps Remember
chapters.summary: Studying her ancestor Sela Okafor's original charts, Rafael realizes they depict not roads but the ward-network itself — a lattice anchored by dragon-fire at the Spire of Thornfell. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: awe curdling into responsibility; inheritance revealed as burden.

chapters.title: The Child Who Smells of Smoke
chapters.summary: In a refugee camp of people 'from nowhere,' Rafael meets Ash, a half-dragon child who remembers the fire at the Spire and insists it is going out. Ash refuses to speak to anyone but Rafael. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: tenderness breaking through her guardedness; first bond of the found family.

chapters.title: Smuggler's Logic
chapters.summary: Rafael plans their route back into Thornfell using only memory, since no map now shows the passes. Imre doubts her; Ash trusts her completely. They slip past a checkpoint where guards literally cannot see the road. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: confidence reclaimed through craft — her skills matter again.

chapters.title: The Astronomer Without a Sky
chapters.summary: They rescue Nadya Solenne, an astronomer imprisoned for insisting the missing stars are 'held' somewhere rather than destroyed. Nadya calculates the stars are trapped inside the failing ward-lattice. POV: Nadya. Emotional beat: intellectual wonder rekindling hope amid fear.

chapters.title: First Pass: The Teeth
chapters.summary: The party crosses the Teeth in a whiteout, navigating by Rafael's childhood memories. An avalanche nearly kills Ash; Rafael digs her out barehanded. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: terror transformed into fierce protectiveness — the group becomes family.

chapters.title: Ghosts of the Survey Corps
chapters.summary: Sheltering in an abandoned survey station, Rafael finds Sela Okafor's final journal: she bound the wards to her own bloodline, and each keeper's death dims the fire. POV: Rafael via journal interludes. Emotional beat: grief for an ancestor she never met, and anger at being conscripted by birthright.

chapters.title: The Hollow Road
chapters.summary: Ash leads them onto the Hollow Road, a passage that exists only between moments, where the erased country's lost things drift like sediment. Rafael glimpses her own possible futures. POV: Ash. Emotional beat: eerie melancholy; the cost of erasure made visible.

chapters.title: Betrayal at the Ford
chapters.summary: A guide they hired sells their route to the Chancellery, which wants Thornfell's erasure permanent. Imre is captured covering the others' escape. POV: Imre. Emotional beat: bitter sacrifice; guilt and loyalty collide.

chapters.title: Interrogation by Candlelight
chapters.summary: Imre stalls her Chancellery interrogator by teaching him ward-theory, buying time while secretly mapping the prison's own wards. POV: Imre. Emotional beat: defiant wit under pressure; dignity preserved through knowledge.

chapters.title: The Guttering
chapters.summary: From a ridge, the party witnesses the Spire's fire dim visibly; the mountains begin fading at the edges, villages dissolving into mist. Ash screams in shared pain. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: urgency sharpened into desperation — days, not weeks.

chapters.title: Prison Break, Cartographer's Method
chapters.summary: Rafael infiltrates the Chancellery archive to steal back Sela's master chart, then springs Imre using a copied key-map. Nadya causes a diversion with a false star-chart panic. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: triumphant competence; the family reunited and whole.

chapters.title: Nadya's Proof
chapters.summary: With the master chart, Nadya confirms the vanished stars are stored in the lattice and can be released if the fire is relit — but only a blood-heir can carry the flame. Rafael is the last Okafor. POV: Nadya. Emotional beat: hope with a knife's edge; the price is named.

chapters.title: What Rafael Wants
chapters.summary: Campfire scene: each character confesses what they'd do if they escaped. Rafael admits she always planned to leave Thornfell forever. Ash quietly says she just wants somewhere that's real. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: quiet devastation; the choice crystallizes.

chapters.title: The Last Ascent
chapters.summary: The party climbs the Spire's switchbacks through dissolving reality, past wardens of the Chancellery who fade mid-swing. Imre takes a wound shielding Ash. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: relentless forward motion; love expressed as endurance.

chapters.title: Sela's Room at the Top
chapters.summary: At the summit, Rafael enters her ancestor's chamber and meets a residual echo of Sela, who offers her the easy path: the Hollow Door out, open one final time. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: temptation and reckoning — everything the story owes comes due.

chapters.title: The Choice of the Heir
chapters.summary: Climax. Rafael refuses the Door, accepts the flame, and lets it pass through her blood into the Spire while the Chancellery's final assault breaches the walls. Imre holds the line; Nadya aligns the release; Ash breathes the first new fire. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: self-immolating courage transfigured into renewal.

chapters.title: Stars, Returning
chapters.summary: The lattice releases the held stars; they scatter back across the sky as Thornfell solidifies, borders blazing with renewed wards. The Chancellery officers forget why they came. POV: Nadya. Emotional beat: cathartic wonder; the impossible made ordinary again.

chapters.title: Redrawing the Map
chapters.summary: Weeks later, Rafael begins a new survey — not to escape Thornfell but to know it. Imre rebuilds the ward-school; Ash attends her first lessons. Rafael adds her own name beneath Sela's in the ledger of keepers. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: belonging chosen freely; identity reconciled with inheritance.

chapters.title: Hollow and Spire
chapters.summary: Epilogue. Years on, Rafael teaches a young apprentice at the Spire, showing her the Hollow Road and telling her about the night the stars went out. Somewhere far away, the Hollow Door stands closed, and no one needs it. POV: Rafael. Emotional beat: peace earned, legacy passed on, the found family enduring.
